title: Measures panel
responsibility: Displays recorded size and performance without estimating missing measurements.

inputs.name: MeasuresPanel.size
inputs.description: Required measure whose nonempty text is displayed, otherwise Not measured. Its available flag controls measured styling.

inputs.name: MeasuresPanel.performance
inputs.description: Required performance measure with the same text fallback; available controls measured styling.

outputs.name: MeasuresPanel
outputs.description: Size & performance panel with the two supplied values. Does not calculate measurements or infer availability from displayed text.
